QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_13

question.text: Per Chapter 12 of the NISM Series XIX-D workbook and the SEBI Master Circular dated July 31, 2023, how many guiding principles constitute the Stewardship Code framework for AIFs in respect of their listed investee exposures?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 12 (pp. 281-282) of the workbook, and the SEBI Master Circular on Stewardship Code for AIFs dated July 31, 2023, lay down SIX principles: (1) comprehensive stewardship policy and disclosure; (2) conflict-of-interest policy; (3) continuous monitoring of investee companies; (4) intervention policy; (5) voting policy and disclosure; (6) periodic reporting on stewardship activities. The stem is anchored to Chapter 12 and the 2023 Master Circular, so 6 is the uniquely correct answer. The Trap: Options 4 and 8 are simple distractors. Option B (7 principles) is plausible because UK / IRDAI variants list more principles, but the SEBI AIF version is 6. Note: The original stem did not anchor itself to a specific source, which created internal conflict with another workbook page (p. 88) that referenced "five principles" and listed only Principles 1-5. The stem has been narrowed to Chapter 12 / the July 31, 2023 SEBI Master Circular, and the "5 principles" distractor has been replaced with "7 principles" so the keyed answer is uniquely correct. Source: 24 NISM-Series-XIX-D Category I and II AIF Managers Certification Examination, January 2026 (pp. 281-282).
